evidence.quotable_sentence: Three of 23 run/arm pairs reached a verified success within 48 turns; all 3 are the pointer-stable arm at cp.0.t12 (turn 12); the other 20 are censored at their horizon, which is a measurement of non-success, not a missing figure.

assumptions.text: Pair space is exactly measure/TVS.json cells[] (23 pairs); repair.t30 excluded (not a declared checkpoint turn, PARM-1-ERRATA).

Per pair, the grade file used is the one measure/TVS.json's own selection picked (measure/cell-*.grade-v5.json), not the stamped twin, so the censored table cannot disagree with the produced TVS values; the twin is a corroboration check only.
turns_observed = max turn present in the arm's rows, not the declared 48; a run that stopped early is censored at the turn it reached.
Censored tokens are the whole observed run (deduplicated); they are spending, never a tvs, and are never averaged or combined with a tokens_to_success value.

All 23 rows are marked grader_unstamped because none of the 9 picked grade files records grader_sha256; rows-longrun-v6-tools is additionally flagged pre-T3 (grade file generated 14:57:22Z, before the 15:56Z boundary) and is never pooled with the current-era events.

Generator persisted inside orchestration/units/TVS-CENSORED.md between #SCRIPT-BEGIN/#SCRIPT-END because /tmp does not persist between shells here; ROOT=os.getcwd() so the frozen command re-derives the JSON in a scratch copy.
